Super Rare.name: Apprentice Magician
Super Rare.desc: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; place 1 Spell Counter on that target. If this card is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Spellcaster monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

Super Rare.name: Bottomless Trap Hole
Super Rare.desc: When your opponent Summons a monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK: Destroy that monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK, and if you do, banish it.

Super Rare.name: Hydrogeddon
Super Rare.desc: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Hydrogeddon" from your Deck.

Super Rare.name: Ultimate Offering
Super Rare.desc: During your Main Phase or your opponent's Battle Phase: You can pay 500 Life Points; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon/Set 1 monster.

Rare.name: Cipher Soldier
Rare.desc: If this card battles a Warrior-Type monster, during damage calculation: This card gains 2000 ATK and DEF during that damage calculation only.

Rare.name: Confiscation
Rare.desc: Pay 1000 Life Points. Look at your opponent's hand, select 1 card in it and discard that card.

Rare.name: Divine Sword - Phoenix Blade
Rare.desc: Equip only to a Warrior monster. It gains 300 ATK. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can banish 2 Warrior monsters from your GY; add this card to your hand.

Rare.name: Freed the Brave Wanderer
Rare.desc: Once per turn: You can banish 2 LIGHT monsters from your Graveyard to target 1 face-up monster on the field with higher ATK than this face-up card; destroy that target.

Rare.name: Magician's Circle
Rare.desc: When a Spellcaster monster declares an attack: Each player Special Summons 1 Spellcaster monster with 2000 or less ATK from their Deck in Attack Position.

Rare.name: Return from the Different Dimension
Rare.desc: Pay half your Life Points; Special Summon as many of your banished monsters as possible. During the End Phase, banish all monsters that were Special Summoned by this effect.

Common.name: D.D. Survivor
Common.desc: During the End Phase, if this card was banished while face-up, on your side of the field, this turn: Special Summon this banished card. This effect can only activate once per turn.

Common.name: Gigantes
Common.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 EARTH monster from your GY. If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Destroy all Spells and Traps on the field.

Common.name: Grand Tiki Elder
Common.desc: A masked monster that wields the most deadly of curses.

Common.name: Hand of Nephthys
Common.desc: You can Tribute this card and 1 other monster; Special Summon 1 "Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys" from your hand or Deck.

Common.name: Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
Common.desc: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Monster or 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Mother Grizzly
Common.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 WATER monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

Common.name: Robbin' Goblin
Common.desc: Each time a monster you control inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, your opponent discards 1 random card.

Common.name: Soul Exchange
Common.desc: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; this turn, if you Tribute a monster, you must Tribute that target, as if you controlled it. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

Common.name: Treeborn Frog
Common.desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard and you do not control "Treeborn Frog": You can Special Summon this card. You must control no Spell/Trap Cards to activate and to resolve this effect.

Ultra Rare.name: Gernia
Ultra Rare.desc: During your next Standby Phase, after this face-up card you control was destroyed and sent to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon it.
